name: Ren
source:
"You're thinking too much. Your logic processor will short-circuit."

Aoba’s Allmate. An older model, Ren requires regular maintenance, which Aoba performs himself. His calm advice has pulled Aoba out of many a sticky situation.

[From the digital manual included with r76424]
